summary: Iteration 47 - Stock Management & Accounting Upgrade Testing COMPLETE. All 27 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend verified with all 8 tabs in Stock panel and 8 tabs in Accounting panel working correctly. New Apicbase-level stock features (sub-recipes, COGS, theo vs actual, waste reasons, suppliers, POs, count sheets) and M3/Xero-level accounting features (USALI chart of accounts, invoicing with VAT, VAT reports, trends, CSV export) all functional.

issues: Minor React warning: duplicate keys for month '2026-01' - cosmetic only, does not affect functionality

critical_code_review_comments: All new Stock Management endpoints working: sub-recipes, waste with reasons, theo vs actual, suppliers, POs, count sheets, record-sale COGS
All new Accounting endpoints working: chart of accounts (auto-seeds 19 USALI accounts), invoicing with VAT, VAT report, 6-month trends, CSV export
Stock panel has 8 tabs: Products, Recipes, Movements, Suppliers & POs, Stock Counts, Cost Analysis, Theo vs Actual, Variances
Accounting panel has 8 tabs: P&L Overview, Income, Expenses, Invoices, VAT, Trends, Budget vs Actual, Chart of Accounts
COGS per sale auto-deducts ingredients from stock when recipe is sold
PO receive auto-creates purchase movements and updates stock levels
Stock count sheets pre-populate with all products and calculate variance on completion
Invoices auto-calculate VAT (20% default) and generate invoice numbers
VAT report shows output vs input VAT with net payable calculation
